prompt: Create a production-ready transparent sprite sheet for a hand-painted 2D side-view cartoon platform game. Water extinguishing a forest fire, EFFECTS ONLY, no character, no fire, no floor/background. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, 1024x1024 canvas. Sixteen completely isolated effects, no grid lines, no text. Each cell has generous empty transparent margins so nothing touches neighbouring cells. Charming painted cel animation, soft white highlights and rich cyan/blue outlines for WATER, pale ivory white with desaturated blue-gray undersides for STEAM, soft painted edges, no neon glow or geometric symbols. Row 1: FOUR consecutive ground splash crown animation frames: low initial impact, wide crown, broken falling droplets, final low rippling splash. Ground contact consistently on 80 percent cell height, width roughly 70 percent cell. Row 2: FOUR consecutive translucent STEAM puff frames: small newly forming white curling puff, billowing lobed steam puff rising, taller loose curling vapor, thin wisps dissipating. Distinct hand-painted shapes with soft semi-transparent edges, no dark soot, no orange. All centered in cells. Row 3: FOUR consecutive low wide wet ground ripple frames: fresh pale blue elliptical water pool, expanding rippled pool, thinning broken rings of water, fading subtle wet trace. Ground pool centered at 65 percent cell height, wide horizontally and shallow vertically. Row 4: FOUR small airborne falling water droplet animation frames: one elongated blue droplet with white highlight in each cell, subtle changes of shape as it falls, each isolated at exact cell center, occupy 30 percent of cell height. This sheet is used for physical falling drops and rising steam so each phase must look clear at small size, restrained luminosity, warm vintage cartoon brush style, transparent background throughout.
